title.narrative: Securing a water desalination plant for the well of the dialysis center at Banadir Hospital in Mogadishu

description.narrative: Providing potable water for dialysis machines, sustainability of service provision, continued efficiency of the machines, water purification and treatment plant, and achieving the benefit from the well
Purchase and supply of a water desalination plant for the well of the dialysis center at Benadir Hospital in Mogadishu. Providing usable water for dialysis machines and sustaining the service.

The readiness of the water well and the benefit of pumping potable water and the readiness of the center to receive and provide its services to kidney failure patients for a number exceeding (250) patients per month, with a total of (2810) direct and indirect beneficiaries of the project.
